headline: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
summary: Microsoft CEO Nadella warns about the inherent dangers of advanced AI. He states we must assume all AI models are 'compromised'. Nadella urges moving past treating AI as "black boxes."

headline: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
summary: DistroKid is removing artist's songs without notice. This is in response to a UMG lawsuit alleging an "AI-slop pipeline." Artists are expressing frustration on social media.

headline: Ledger wallet tampering suspected after reports of crypto thefts
summary: Ledger crypto wallet users report accounts being drained. Tampered hardware sold by CryptoBillis is suspected. Ledger halted CryptoBillis sales to investigate.

headline: K-pop star Sunmi loves Notion and ear cleaning videos
summary: K-pop icon Sunmi, formerly of Wonder Girls, shares her personal interests. She uses Notion for organization. Sunmi also enjoys ear cleaning videos.

headline: Arc Raiders' 2.0 Update and 'Spider-Man' Grappling Hook Drive Player Count to Reach 7-Month High
summary: Arc Raiders 2.0 update boosts player count to a seven-month high. New features include a "Spider-Man" grappling hook and a new map. A free weekend also contributed to the surge.

headline: Image Comics' Roam Reunites Paper Girls Creators Brian K. Vaughan and Cliff Chiang
summary: Paper Girls creators Brian K. Vaughan and Cliff Chiang announce a new comic series. Their new project is titled "Roam" from Image Comics. The reunion was an exclusive reveal at NYCC.

headline: Crystal Lake Showrunner on Retelling the Friday the 13th Story: ‘It’s Always Ripe for Reinterpretation’
summary: Crystal Lake showrunner discusses reinterpreting the Friday the 13th story. Brad Caleb Kane believes the story is "always ripe for reinterpretation." Linda Cardellini and other cast members were interviewed.

headline: DC Legend Grant Morrison Criticizes 'Morally and Legally Incoherent' Lanterns Finale
summary: DC veteran Grant Morrison critiques the Lanterns series finale. Morrison found the finale "morally and legally incoherent." Their review included multiple criticisms.

headline: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
summary: An attack on Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia killed twelve. 309 people were also injured in the incident. The Saudi-led coalition calls the Houthi attack a "war crime."

headline: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
summary: Donald Trump states it's "Time for Ukraine to get new president." This follows Zelensky's condemnation of a diesel deal with Russia. Zelensky said the deal would help Russia fund its war.

headline: Man dies after tiger attack at wildlife park
summary: A man died after being attacked by a tiger. The incident occurred at a wildlife park near Doncaster. Police report the man entered the tiger enclosure.

headline: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
summary: US murderer Christa Pike was discharged from the hospital. This follows her failed execution attempt 10 days prior. Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" for her medical care.
